name: Kat-Net TSPS
author: noreply@kat-net.us
description: A browser RuneScape private server (TSPS, the Kat-Net edition): the game server and its website on one port. Players open the server's address in a browser; nothing to download. Needs Node.js 22, one port, 4 GB of memory or more and 5 GB of disk.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The egg's install script (it is copied into egg-kat-net-tsps.json by make-egg.mjs).
# Runs once, as root, in the install container (node:22-bookworm), with the server's files at
# /mnt/server and the egg's variables in the environment. Running it again ("Reinstall" in the
# panel) fetches the project afresh and keeps everything that is not the project's: player
# saves, the game cache, .env and world.local.json.
set -e
cd /mnt/server

REPO="${GIT_REPO:-https://github.com/katnightfall/ksps.git}"
BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-main}"
git config --global --add safe.directory '*'

echo "[egg] Fetching $REPO ($BRANCH)..."
if [ ! -d .git ]; then
    git init -q .
    git remote add origin "$REPO"
else
    git remote set-url origin "$REPO"
fi
git fetch --depth 1 origin "$BRANCH"
git checkout -q -f -B "$BRANCH" FETCH_HEAD
git branch -q --set-upstream-to="origin/$BRANCH" "$BRANCH" || true

# Packages, the game server and the website: the same steps a start runs when something changed.
node deploy/pterodactyl/launch.mjs --prepare

echo "[egg] Installed. Start the server: its first start downloads the game cache."

variables.name: World name
variables.description: The world's name, also shown on the login screen's server button. Changing it rebuilds the website on the next start (several minutes).

variables.name: World description
variables.description: A line about the world, shown with its name.

variables.name: XP rate
variables.description: Experience multiplier: 1 is as the original game, 10 is ten times as fast.

variables.name: Bots
variables.description: How many levelling bots walk the world (they start as new characters and train like players). 0 turns every bot off. More bots need more memory and processor.

variables.name: Developer accounts
variables.description: Account names that are developers (the highest rank) each time they log in, comma-separated. Create the account in game first: a name listed here that nobody has registered yet belongs to whoever logs in with it first.

variables.name: Public game address
variables.description: Only for a world list: where players reach the game from outside, for example wss://play.example.com. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: Update on start
variables.description: 1: fetch the newest version of the project each time the server starts, and rebuild what changed. 0: stay on the version installed.

variables.name: Rebuild on start
variables.description: 1: build everything again on the next start, whatever changed (after editing the project's source by hand). Set it back to 0 afterwards.

variables.name: Game memory (MB)
variables.description: Memory for the game server in MB. Empty: 70% of the server's memory.

variables.name: Project address
variables.description: The git address the project is installed and updated from.

variables.name: Project branch
variables.description: The branch of the project to install.
